text:
```yaml
name: Repomix Packaging
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  repomix-pack:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Pack Repository with Repomix
        uses: repomix/repomix-action@main
        with:
          compress: true

      - name: Upload Repomix Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: repomix-packed-repository
          path: repomix-output.tar.gz
          compression-level: 9
```
